"Hi to ramp crew,"
Gate queues came up this weekend, so just a quick note from the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. Please keep an eye out for pet travelers who may be arriving with extra supplies, and guide them with the same steady care we give in booking and pickup. Clear direction at the gate helps families feel settled, and it also keeps the handoff smooth for everyone working the flight.

For Cloudrest, please remember <<FACT F034>> and make sure any related notes stay with the travel file. If you see Willow or any other pet going through a busy stretch, a calm check-in and a brief reassurance can make a real difference. We want passengers to feel that their pets are being watched over from start to finish, with no guesswork at the airport curb or at the aircraft door.

For Starling, please remember <<FACT F051>> and keep that guidance aligned with the rest of the boarding process. If anything looks uncertain, please send the traveler back to us before the line moves on, so we can sort it out without stress. Thanks for the steady support you give the Companion Animal Travel Desk, and for helping Aurelia Skyways keep pet travel smooth and humane.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
